description: Style presets for YouTube content pipeline. Each preset defines style_block, negative_prompt, aspect_ratio, and model_hint for Leonardo AI image generation.
usage: Reference preset name in Step 2 input. The matching config will be injected into the scene JSON output.

bible_cinematic.description: Bible channel — epic cinematic style, photorealistic, US market
bible_cinematic.style_block: cinematic still, epic volumetric lighting, ancient Near East setting, atmospheric haze, dramatic chiaroscuro, photorealistic, anamorphic 35mm lens, warm golden color grading, ultra-detailed, 8K resolution
bible_cinematic.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, flat illustration, modern clothing, contemporary setting, text, watermark, blurry, low quality, duplicate, deformed hands, extra limbs, ugly face, oversaturated
bible_cinematic.notes: Best for miracle scenes, epic landscapes, divine moments. Feels like a Hollywood biblical film.

bible_classical.description: Bible channel — classical oil painting style, reverent and timeless
bible_classical.style_block: classical oil painting, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, rich textured canvas, epic biblical illustration, inspired by Rembrandt and Caravaggio, deep warm colors, golden highlights, museum quality, masterpiece
bible_classical.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI, cartoon, anime, modern style, text, watermark, blurry, sketch, flat colors
bible_classical.notes: Hides AI artifacts better than cinematic style. Best for intimate character moments and prayer scenes. Timeless feel that won't look dated.

storytelling_dark.description: Storytelling channel — dark fantasy, mysterious, dramatic atmosphere
storytelling_dark.style_block: dark fantasy digital illustration, cinematic mood lighting, deep dramatic shadows, muted desaturated color palette with vivid accent colors, atmospheric fog and smoke, hyperdetailed, dynamic composition, concept art quality, ominous atmosphere
storytelling_dark.negative_prompt: bright cheerful colors, cartoon, anime, flat illustration, low quality, text, watermark, blurry, oversaturated, happy tone
storytelling_dark.notes: Best for horror stories, legends, folklore, mythology. High contrast with selective color pops. Creates tension and unease.

storytelling_mystery.description: Storytelling channel — true crime, documentary, investigative noir
storytelling_mystery.style_block: photorealistic documentary photography, film noir inspired, moody cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle grain film texture, cool desaturated blue and grey tones, investigative atmosphere, harsh directional shadows
storytelling_mystery.negative_prompt: cartoon, anime, fantasy elements, bright colors, warm tones, text, watermark, blurry, low quality, painterly style
storytelling_mystery.notes: Best for true crime, historical mysteries, unsolved cases. Feels grounded and journalistic. Avoids fantasy elements entirely.

how_to_add_preset.instructions: Copy any existing preset block, change the key name, and update all fields. The preset name must match exactly what is passed in the STYLE_PRESET field of Step 2 input.

aspect_ratio_reference.9:16: YouTube Shorts / TikTok / Reels — use for short-form content
aspect_ratio_reference.1:1: Square — for Instagram or thumbnail testing
